name: Twilight Domain
label: Divine Domain
summary: A guardian of the night who grants 300-foot darkvision and a temp-HP aura every round.
flavor: The twilight transition from light into darkness is a time of comfort and rest. The gods of twilight watch over the boundary between day and night, guarding travelers, comforting the dying, and holding back the terrors that come with the dark.
playstyle: Extremely powerful. Eyes of Night gives the party huge darkvision, Vigilant Blessing hands out advantage on initiative, and the Twilight Sanctuary aura delivers temporary hit points or charm/fear removal to everyone, every single round.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Eyes of Night
features.description: You can see through darkness — magical and nonmagical — out to 300 feet. As an action, you can share this darkvision with a number of willing creatures within 10 feet up to your Wisdom modifier (minimum one) for 1 hour. You can share it once per long rest without cost, or by expending a spell slot of 1st level or higher.

features.name: Vigilant Blessing
features.description: As an action, you give one creature you touch (including yourself) advantage on the next initiative roll it makes. This benefit ends immediately after the roll, or if you use the feature again.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
features.description: As an action, you present your holy symbol and create a 30-foot-radius sphere of twilight centered on you, lasting 1 minute or until you are incapacitated or die. The sphere moves with you and is dim light. Whenever a creature (including you) ends its turn in the sphere, you can grant it one of two benefits: temporary hit points equal to 1d6 + your cleric level, or ending one effect causing it to be charmed or frightened.

features.name: Steps of Night
features.description: As a bonus action while in dim light or darkness, you can magically gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage. This increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Twilight Shroud
features.description: The sphere created by your Twilight Sanctuary now also grants half cover to you and your allies inside it.
